mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances with UNRATE below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of quarters with jointly increasing HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with jointly favorable labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 2.5% YoY) in conjunction with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY) signals a 'goldilocks' economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with jointly favorable GDP and inflation growth.
